propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted consumes 15+ seconds with a 10-second production window; inject a 1-second test window and verify sustained above-floor traffic for more than one complete window without stall classification.

test_read_retried_then_terminal executes real child processes across production 2s/4s retry backoffs totaling ~9 seconds; inject sub-second call/grace/drain values and record logical retry schedule without sleeping.
ACLI read retry sentinel must launch exactly _MAX_ATTEMPTS real process sessions and record all parent-side PIDs to verify absence after terminal failure.
Production timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt, and backoff defaults must remain unchanged and byte-identical.
Both test modules must complete in low single-digit seconds using real subprocess/socket execution without absolute wall-clock pass thresholds.
